_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: adoptions list
cli_commands.description: List adoption records (--component-id ID, --scenario NAME, --limit N)

cli_commands.name: adoptions apply
cli_commands.description: Copy a component version into a target scenario and record the adoption

cli_commands.name: adoptions reapply
cli_commands.description: Overwrite an adoption from a selected library version

cli_commands.name: adoptions delete
cli_commands.description: Delete an adoption record by id

cli_commands.name: adoptions refresh
cli_commands.description: Recompute drift status for every adoption (or one component's; use --component-id ID)

cli_commands.name: components index
cli_commands.description: Walk the source root and refresh the components registry

cli_commands.name: components list
cli_commands.description: List indexed components (--match SUBSTR, --tag TAG, --tags a,b, --category CAT, --limit N)

cli_commands.name: components get
cli_commands.description: Get a component by id

cli_commands.name: components get-by-library-id
cli_commands.description: Get a component by its @libraryId header value

cli_commands.name: components init
cli_commands.description: Initialize a new Git-tracked component folder and first version

cli_commands.name: components version-create
cli_commands.description: Create a new component version folder

cli_commands.name: components manifest-update
cli_commands.description: Update component manifest metadata and version pointers

cli_commands.name: components content-get
cli_commands.description: Read a component's source file

cli_commands.name: components content-set
cli_commands.description: Write a component's source file (use - to read from stdin)

cli_commands.name: components versions
cli_commands.description: List indexed versions for a component

cli_commands.name: components show-version
cli_commands.description: Read the source for a component version

cli_commands.name: deps list
cli_commands.description: List parsed @deps declarations for a component (req 10)

cli_commands.name: deps validate
cli_commands.description: Validate a component's @deps against a target scenario's package.json (verdict: ok/warn/block)

cli_commands.name: preview bundle
cli_commands.description: Print the esbuild-transpiled ES module for a component (used by the live-preview iframe and for diagnostics)

cli_commands.name: themes list-builtin
cli_commands.description: List the built-in themes seeded into the registry (req 12)

cli_commands.name: themes get-builtin
cli_commands.description: Get a built-in theme by id, including its CSS-custom-property token map

cli_commands.name: themes get-from-scenario
cli_commands.description: Resolve a theme from a target scenario's DESIGN.md (server-side; client never parses DESIGN.md directly)

cli_commands.name: versions list
cli_commands.description: List recorded versions for a component (--limit N)

cli_commands.name: versions show
cli_commands.description: Show a specific recorded version (--with-content to include the body)

cli_commands.name: versions diff
cli_commands.description: Diff two versions or a version and an adoption:<id>
